notes.title: Moral Choices and Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Today's update brings some [b]additions to the Infamy system and character friendship values[/b] in Infinite Mana. I always felt the system could be a little more, and your feedback has only made me want to add to it. You will find new NPCs to interact with throughout the world which you can either help or hinder/harm which will raise or lower your [b]Outstanding Infamy[/b] - the choice is up to you! You will also gain Outstanding Infamy from being sent to jail. This system will pave the way for a future update in which your choices will play a larger role.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/670b2af06473bb249e01915aef1cb4633353110e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Small changes to several Guises.
[*] Fixes for incorrect items, descriptions, and event placements.
[*] Various grammar/spelling fixes.
[*] Various performance fixes.
[/list]

And there are a few other things on the way though I do not have a timeframe for a few, I just want you to be aware that they are being worked on:

[list]
[*] The soundtrack will be out in a couple weeks!
[*] A performance build that may fix performance issues for many people.
[*] Linux and Mac builds.
[/list]

As always, a huge thanks to everyone in Discord who's been reporting bugs and giving feedback!

notes.title: Bugfixes For June 10th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hi all, just a few bugfixes today. Thanks for the reports!

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where sleeping at the Wynn or Al'tuad inns could teleport the player to the Void.
[*] Resolved an issue where the main character's skin color could be different on the field and in battle.
[*] City guards now respawn after a while, fixing an issue where they didn't.
[*] Fixed an issue where a certain Guardian was still present on screen after the cutscene.
[*] Resolved an issue where future characters were not able to learn the Rogue's Pilfer skill.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Spellblade's final skill granting a lower percentage of TP than intended.
[*] Various grammar/spelling fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes For May 16th, 2024
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just a quick update today. I fixed a few issues where the incorrect music file was trying to play in the cities of Varonia and Bargeport, so if you ran into that issue it's fixed.

Still on track for release in a couple weeks!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
It's time! After nearly a year in Early Access I'm proud to announce that Infinite Mana finally has a release date: [b]Tuesday, May 28th, 2024![/b]

The game is essentially playable from start to finish at this point, but I'd like to spend the time leading up to release to put the final polish on the game. Check out the release date trailer:

[previewyoutube=sJa4SjnRTn4;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is some extra detail from Patreon that I thought I should include here as well:

[i]I want to thank everyone who has supported me and the game. It's been a very long journey and I appreciate everyone who has taken the time to play the game, report bugs, and be a part of the community.

Patreon has helped with a lot of things including website hosting fees, advertising, assets, and more. A lot of people have been subbed since I opened the Patreon, and I want to include you as a character in the final game. There is a Top Patron role that says you'll get an in-game character as long as you subbed for one month, but if you've subbed for the other tiers for many months that add up to Top Patron, I'd like to add you as well, If you're a little shy of that tier, that's okay too. Please reach out to me either on Discord, Twitter, or Patreon and we'll start that process.

Now, really... what's next? Even though the game will be finished very soon, I do have plans for more content, and some of it you can see in the images attached to this post. I'm not sure of the timeline for this content, but essentially I want players to explore the rest of the Far West at some point. There will be more details in the coming months but I did want to share that this isn't the end for Infinite Mana![/i]

With all that being said, there will be a final trailer as well before the actual release so stay tuned to that (Added above!). Thanks everyone!
